title: ranunculus acris var. propinquus
intro: Ranunculus acris var. propinquus, commonly known as Meadow Buttercup, is a flowering plant that belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat fever, sore throat, and rheumatism. The health benefits of Ranunculus acris var. propinquus include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative and anti-inflammatory effects.
